is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 1, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for kdr-East (Vgsc L995S) and kdr-West (Vgsc L995F) (page 1, abstract; page 4, methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports that of 100 samples, 99% were positive for kdr-East and 1% for kdr-West (page 1, abstract; page 6, results).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Tulukuyi village, Bungoma, Kenya (page 2, methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research study (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Tulukuyi village, Bungoma County, Kenya (page 2, methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted in April and May 2018 (page 2, methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection and analysis of mosquitoes from Tulukuyi village in 2018.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data (frequencies) is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study characterized the microbiota of 100 permethrin-resistant and susceptible F1 progeny of field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Tulukuyi, Kenya. It also genotyped these mosquitoes for kdr-East and kdr-West mutations, finding 99% fixation of the kdr-East allele.
